capture.zh: 在钮斯处接受「忍之秘宝第四季」，激活塔克星忍魂密室的全部四个玄关后，斯普林特在第二层地底古迹复苏，点击挑战；打败获得斯普林特精元（孵化得斯林德）。

strategy_notes.zh: 「这个新BOSS并不难」：40级以上波克尔/闪光波克尔同生共死一次后收尾；或盖亚消强化后谱尼解决。

engine_notes: 同生共死 works (the cheapest classic strategy), so it is not immune to it.
Innate boost implied by '先用盖亚消强化'; atk+2, as unstated innate boosts are atk+2 (user decision 2026-10-19). HP and level: 4399 2011 summary says 80级; HP 4000 is an estimate.
Its 虚空之身/黑暗遮蔽 make physical/special attacks miss for 2 turns — skill effects.
skills: no source names (all of) the boss's moves; remaining slots use the species' top learnset skills, which is what every documented 2010-2012 SPT boss used.
reward: 精元 item (kind essence) hatching the base form of the line at Lv1, as the original 分子转化器 did (e.g. 里奥斯精元 → 胡里亚, 阿克希亚精元 → 索拉, 斯普林特精元 → 斯林德).
source_note: 4399 图鉴 + 5068 (2011-04-29): 忍魂密室第二层地底古迹, 激活四玄关后出现, 精元孵化斯林德; 4399 2011: 80级.
